title: Crediting Practice Memorandum: Long-Standing Whole Life Insurance Accumulation Deposits
content:
**Subject:** rate credited on the dividend accumulation deposit of an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy.

The rate credited is raised for a long-standing deposit, judged by the number of dividend deposit entries on the policy ledger as it stands on the day the credit is processed:

- at least **10** entries: raised by **0.40 percentage point (0.004)**;
- at least **5** but fewer than 10 entries: raised by **0.20 percentage point (0.002)**;
- fewer than **5** entries: not raised on this account.

Each dividend deposit entry on the activity history counts once.

| Entries | 4 | 5 | 9 | 10 | 14 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Increase | None | 0.002 | 0.002 | 0.004 | 0.004 |

**Example (hypothetical, declared rate 3.75%).** Twelve deposit entries: 4.15%. Six entries: 3.95%.
